description: E3: the Hollow Titan keeping his vigil on one knee at the King's Field's north side, his sword planted before him - a world boss held by his territory (world.kingsward.hollow_territory, TitanTerritory: a giant he sees wakes him; he hunts to 135 m of the field's middle and walks home whole). An arena encounter (no leash), its seat reserved within 200 m (reserve_seat) and his AI at the near tier within 400 m (lod_near_m), as the other titans'. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag).
